environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with public-facing DNS. The ALB forwards all HTTP traffic directly to the origin on port 5000. No input validation middleware is configured. The LDAP server (OpenLDAP 2.6) is accessible from the application subnet on port 389 with bind credentials stored in appsettings.json. Security groups allow inbound 443/80 from 0.0.0.0/0 to the ALB and ALB-to-EC2 on port 5000.
